# Manufacturing Business Glossary

This glossary defines the core business concepts and terminology used in the manufacturing supply chain domain. It covers product structures, materials management, production workflows, and quality assurance processes.

## Product

A Product represents any manufactured item in the system, including finished goods ready for sale, sub-assemblies used in production, and individual components. Products are organized in a hierarchical structure where complex product... [TRUNCATED]

## Warehouse

A Warehouse represents a physical storage location where materials, components, and finished goods are stored. Warehouses have defined capacity limits, geographic location information, and are managed by designated managers. Warehouses serve as nodes in the supply chain network where inventory is held, shipments are received, and products are staged for production or distribution.

**Key Attributes:**
- Unique warehouse identifier
- Warehouse name and location
- Address, city, and ... [TRUNCATED]

## QualityControl

Quality Control (QC) represents inspection and testing activities performed on materials, in-process production, or finished goods. QC records track the type of inspection (incoming, in-process, final), inspection date, inspector, test results (pass, fail, conditional), defect counts, and notes. QC activities are associated with specific production batches and may reference technical specifications being tested.

- Unique QC identifier

tables_enriched.name: Product
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about products, including identifiers, names, types, hierarchical relationships to parent products, pricing cost, lead time, and whether the product is active.

tables_enriched.name: component
tables_enriched.description: Stores details about individual components, including their identifiers, names, categories, measurement units, standard cost, and associated specification identifiers.

tables_enriched.name: Bill of Materials
tables_enriched.description: Stores the components that constitute each bill of materials, including the relationship between a parent product and its component products, the quantity and unit of measure required, the BOM level, ... [TRUNCATED]

tables_enriched.name: supplier
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about supplier entities, including contact details, quality rating, and whether the supplier is preferred.

tables_enriched.name: warehouse
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about each warehouse, including its identifier, name, location, capacity, and the manager responsible for the facility.

tables_enriched.name: Inventory
tables_enriched.description: Stores current inventory levels and restocking information for components and products across warehouses, including quantities on hand, reserved quantities, and when restocking is required.

tables_enriched.name: Work Order
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of work orders for producing or procuring items, including quantities planned and completed, status and priority, with references to the product and the warehouse.

tables_enriched.name: Shipment
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of shipments including the type, involved warehouse and supplier, customer, key dates, and current status.

tables_enriched.name: quality_control
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of quality control checks performed on batches, including the type of check, date, inspector, outcomes, and any defects observed.

tables_enriched.name: Specification
tables_enriched.description: Stores specification data for Products or Processes, including identifiers, names, versions, effective dates, types, critical parameters, range values, and units of measure.

tables_enriched.name: Batch
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of product batches, including quantities produced, production and expiry dates, warehouse location, and QC status.

tables_enriched.name: Route
tables_enriched.description: Stores the routing steps for products, listing the sequence of operations, associated work centers, and time metrics for each route.

tables_enriched.name: Component Supplier
tables_enriched.description: Stores the relationship between components and suppliers, including whether a supplier is preferred and the lead time and unit price for each component supplied.
